payload.body_you: The plan with {{holder1}} changes again. The call does not happen, the reservation is still not made, or another responsibility quietly becomes yours. After a while, an explanation does not change the fact that you are the person doing the extra work.
payload.body_they: {{holder1}} keeps track of the date, follows up, or finishes the part that did not get done. Another apology may not mean much if {{holder1}} is still losing time because the same responsibility keeps ending up with them.
